content: Jesus Heals a Paralyzed Man
Pu Jesus pākihut aqw pakit, wuhkovatuphat yámakqe, nāp kitsókiy aw pitu.

Noqw meh, hakim hakiy ahpa’ qataytaqat tūtuyhqat ahpat aṅ wáökiwtaqat Jesus aw wikvaya. Noqw pam pumuy qapēvewniyamuy amumi túwahqe, it tūtuyhqat aw paṅqawu: Itii, um qa hin unaṅway’tani; pay uhqaanhtipu uhpiy ayo yukiwa.
Noqw hakim tutavot tūtutuqaynayaqam pep yesqam unaṅwpeq paṅqaqwa: I’ tāqa God aqw hiṅqawu.
Noqw Jesus pumuy wuwniyamuy mātsi’taqe amumi paṅqawu: Ya uma hinoqw umuh’unaṅwpeq qalomáwuwantota?
Ya hinwat lavayhtiniqw qa pas pas hinta? sen Uhqaanhtipu uhpiy ayo yukiwa, kitaniqö’? sen Wunuptut, nakwsuu, kitaniqö’?

Noqw pay pi nu’ Sinot Tiat yep qatsit ep hakiy ahpiy qaanhtipuyat ayo yúkuniqey aw öqalat pasiwtaqat uma it akw nanaptani‐pu pam it hakiy ahpa’ qataytaqat aw paṅqawu: Wunuptut, uh’ahpay kwusut, um nímani.
Noqw pam wunuptut, kiy aw’i.
Noqw k̇aysiwhqam sinom put aw tāyuṅqe, God pas hihtatota, pam hakiy sinot pas panhaqam öqalat máqahqat ep’e.
Jesus Calls Matthew
Noqw Jesus paṅqw ahpiynihqe, hakiy tāqat Matthew yan mātsiwhqat haqam moṅwit eṅem sīvat ömalalwaqat ep qatuqw tuwa; nihqe put aw paṅqawu: Um inuṅkni. Noqw pam wunuptut put aṅki.

Noqw ahpiy pantaqw, Jesus put aw nánatuwnayaqamuy amumum Matthewt kīyat ep ökihqe, pep tunösvoñat aw yesq, k̇aysiwhqam moṅwit eṅem sīvat ömalalwaqam‐niqw pu qaanhinwisqam paṅso ökihqe, pumuy amumum put aw yesva.
Noqw Pharisee‐sinom put aw tātayyaqe, put aw nánatuwnayaqamuy amumi paṅqaqwa: Noqw umuy tutuqaynaqa hinoqw moṅwit eṅem sīvat ömalalwaqamuy‐nik̇aṅw, pu qaanhinwisqamuy amumum tūmoyta?
Noqw Jesus put navotqe, pumuy amumi paṅqawu: Pay aṅ qahinyuṅqam tūhik̇at qa haqni’yuṅwa; nawus pi tūtuyyaqam put haqni’yuṅwa.

Uma yaṅqw ahpiyye’, tutuvenit aṅ pupriye’, pahsat pu it lavayyukit māmatsyani: Uma tūookwatuwyaniqat nu put tuṅlay’ta; noqw uma soq hom’oyit‐sa inumi noaya, it’a. Pi nu aṅ súanhinwisqamuy qa pumuy wáṅwayniqe ōviy pitu; pi nu imuy qaanhinwisqamuy nāp tunatyay aṅqw lasyaniqat aw wáṅwayniqw ōviy pitu.
The Question about Fasting
Pahsat pu John aw nánatuwnayaqam Jesus aw ökihqe aw paṅqaqwa: Itam‐niqw pu Pharisee‐sinom piép nānapwalaṅwu. Noqw ya hintaqw ōviy ūmi nánatuwnayaqam qa pantsatsk̇a?

Noqw Jesus pumuy amumi paṅqawu: Ya sen haqam mö’wit ep sinoiwyuṅqam möönaṅwuy pumuy amumumniqw napwalni’yuṅwni? Nīk̇aṅw pay ason hisat aw pituqw, möönaṅw pumuy nawhkiwni; noqw pep pu’ puma nānapwalani.
Qa hak sino puhutsatsakwmötsaput yewaskwit aw pihtaknaṅwu. Ispi hak panhtiqw, put ep pihtakqa yuwsit aṅqw tsikq, pu’ pas pāpu wukoprokṅwu.

Piw qa haq pi hak puk̇awikorot sakwíiwmaqat aṅ puhuovavalat kuhkuya; pi hakiy panhtiqw, ovavala pēke’ wiwkorot patomnani, nen aṅqw kūyiwtaqa wehemhtini, noqw wiwkoro sakwitotini. Pi puma puhuovavalat puhuwiwkorot aṅ kukyaṅwu; noqw pam qa hinhtiṅwu.
The Official’s Daughter and the Woman who Touched Jesus’ Cloak
Noqw nāt pam pumuy amumi yan yuaataqw, meh, hak moṅwi pítuhqe, Jesus aw naokiwtat, aw paṅqawu: Okiw iti māna nāt pas pu’ mōki. Noqw um as awnen, aw uhmay akw toṅokq pam ahoy tātayni.
Noqw Jesus wunuptut put aṅki, pu put aw nánatuwnayaqamu.
Noqw pam aqwniqw, hak wuhti pakwt lȫq sihk̇ay’taqat yahsaṅwuy aṅ uṅway qa huruhtaqey akw tūtuyhqa put ahkwayñaqw aw pítuhqe, yuwsiyat qalawṅwayat aw toṅo,
Pam unaṅwpeq paṅqawhqe ōviy’o: Ṅas’ew pi nu as yuwsiyat aw tóṅok̇e’, pay soon qa qaluptuni.
Noqw pam panhtiqw, Jesus namtökt, put túwahqe aw paṅqawu: Itii, pay um qahin unaṅway’tani; pay uhqapevewni uṅ qalaptsina. Noqw pahsat pay wuhti qalaptu.
Pu Jesus moṅwit kīyat aw pákihqe, lēlenyaqamuy pu k̇aysiwhqamuy sinmuy pep saáatotaqamuy amumi yórikqe,
Paṅqawu: Huvam ayoyaay! Pay māna qa mōki, pi pūwi. Noqw puma put aw tutsíwtsuyhti.
Pu ōviy pam sinmuy paṅqw nöṅaknat, ahpami pákihqe, mānat māyat ṅuaqw, pam qatuptu.
Noqw pam pep paniwhtiqa put tutskwat aṅ ahsupoq yuaatiwa.
Jesus Heals Two Blind Men
Noqw Jesus paṅqw ahpiyniqw, hakim lȫyöm qapostalqam put aṅk tsa’timaqe paṅqawma: David tíata, okiw itamuy ōkwatuwaa!
Noqw pam kīmi pakiqw, qapostalqam put aw pitu. Noqw Jesus pumuy amumi paṅqawu: Ya nuy panhtiniqey tuwi’taqat uma tuptsiwa? Noqw puma put aw paṅqawu: Owi Tutuyqawhqa.
Pahsat pu pam pōsiyamuy aw toṅo paṅqawk̇aṅwo: Pay uma hinhaqam qapēvewnaqat pan umuṅem hintani.
Noqw pumuy pōsiam tālawva; noqw Jesus pumuy pās mēwaqe paṅqawu: Uma hapi tunatyaltiqw, qa hak it navotni.
Noqw tuwat soq puma paṅqw ahpiynihqe, pam pumuy pantsanqat put tutskwat aṅ ahsupoq kúrukna.
Jesus Heals a Dumb Man
Noqw pumuy paṅqw yámaktoqw, meh, hakim hakiy qayuáataqat nukpanhikwsit akw tuyqawiwtaqat Jesus aw wikvaya.
Noqw nukpanhikwsit put aṅqw ayo tūviwhq, qayuáataqa yuaayku. Noqw sinom suhpantaqam k̇ātayuṅqe paṅqaqwa: Pas qa hisat Israel‐sinmuy amuhpe yan hiniwhtiqw hak aw yori, kitota.
Noqw tuwat Pharisee‐sinom paṅqaqwa: Pam nukpanhihikwsimuy moṅwíyamuy aw yank̇aṅw, nukpanhihikwsimuy ipwanta.
Jesus Has Pity for the People

Noqw Jesus paṅ wuhkokitsokit aṅ‐nik̇aṅw pu pay kitsókit aṅ nakwsuqe pumuy tsotsvalkiyamuy aṅ pumuy tutuqaynatinuma; pu moṅwtunatyat ahpiy lomatuawit yuaatinuma; pu sinmuy amuhpa’ sohsokmuy tūtuyyaqamuy qalaptsintinuma, pu sohsok hihta akw ȫpuiwyuṅqamuyu.
Nihqe pam k̇aysiwhqamuy sinmuy amumi yórikqe pumuy ökwatuwa, maṅwúiwyuṅqw ōviy’o, pas kanelmuy amumi qa hak tunatyawtaqw puma ahtsavaliwyuṅwa.
Pahsat pu pam put aw nánatuwnayaqamuy amumi paṅqawu: Pas hapi as ūyi qaan’ewakw tukwsiwta, noqw tsovalayaniqam híkiyomu.
Oviy uma ūyi’taqat aw nānawaknaqw, pam hakimuy ūyiy aw ayatani.
